# Inspector Icons

Seven unmodified Lucide SVGs downloaded from the official `lucide-icons/lucide` repository
on 2026-10-11: rotate-3d, zoom-in, zoom-out, focus, rotate-ccw, pause and play.

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/main/icons
License: accompanying LICENSE (ISC; included Feather-derived icons carry the MIT notice).
Documentation: https://lucide.dev/license

They are local assets; no CDN/runtime package is required. CSS inverts their black strokes
for the dark toolbar. Each button supplies its accessible name and hover title.
